summary: ITER180 ACTIVATION FOUNDATION™ — Backend 10/10 pytest PASS, Frontend critical flows all GREEN. Backend: GET /api/tenant-onboarding/activation-foundation returns canonical 6-step structure (identity, blueprint, team, first_lead, first_prospect, first_journey) with items[], completed, total=6, progress%, activated bool, next_action (first missing critical). Step order verified. CTA route 'modal:new-relationship' confirmed on first_lead+first_journey, '/settings/identity' on identity. Identity step is already done for seed tenant (name=MOOD for DESIGN, primary_market=IT, language=it-IT, timezone=Europe/Rome). POST /api/tenant-onboarding/identity persists name, default_language, default_locale_code, branding_settings.{primary_market,timezone}; partial updates preserve identity state. Unauthenticated calls correctly rejected (401). Copy Governance C3: catalogue contains NONE of {atmosfera, cinematic, ecosistema, curatoriale}. Frontend on /dashboard: PersistentAlertBanner sticky visible at top (data-testid='activation-banner') with copy 'Activation Foundation™ · 1/6 · Blueprint Chameleon™ — Scegli lo stile visivo che definisce lo studio', dismiss button (data-testid='activation-banner-dismiss') hides the banner. ActivationFoundationCard renders ActivationMeter ('1 / 6 step' progress bar) and WorkspaceActivationChecklist with all 6 data-testid='activation-step-{key}'. STEP 0 /settings/identity reachable, form has 4 fields (identity-name, identity-market as SELECT, identity-language as SELECT, identity-timezone as SELECT) + 'identity-save' button; submit redirects to /dashboard. Smart CTA Routing: 'Apri Nuova Relazione' button on first_lead step opens NewRelationshipModal (CRM · NUOVA RELAZIONE / 'Da dove vuoi iniziare?' with Nuovo Lead / Prospect esistente / Cliente esistente). Auth uses localStorage key 'mfd_session' (NOT 'token') — confirmed.

_activation_state computes live signals from tenants + tenant_atelier_identity + users_profile + leads + accounts + design_journeys — no hardcoded flags, RBAC correctly forbids 'client' role with 403.
POST /identity is properly scoped to {tenant_admin, super_admin}; partial updates are idempotent and preserve branding_settings via merge pattern.
Frontend uses the api wrapper correctly — localStorage key is 'mfd_session' (full JSON session), NOT legacy 'token'. Bearer Authorization is applied transparently.
PersistentAlertBanner is sticky at the very top of the dashboard chrome, with concise IT copy + concrete next-step CTA ('Apri impostazioni'). Hidden when data.activated=true is the right contract.
Smart CTA Routing™ is correctly bifurcated: cta_route='modal:new-relationship' opens NewRelationshipModal, '/...' paths use react-router navigate. Verified via click on first_lead step.

Identity form is admin-only, all 4 required fields present with data-testids, save → /dashboard redirect works. Pre-filled values for the seed tenant come from /activation-foundation.items[0].metadata.values (good UX choice).
